verdicts.reason: R9 open-set + whole-sentence cloze; situation visible, cloze only 'responsible person'

fix.Text: A critically ill patient asks you to notify his family but cannot help you locate them. You need not do it yourself, as long as you ensure a {{c1::responsible person::who}} makes the effort to locate them.
fix.Back Extra: Why: assuring the patient that someone will make the notifications is itself part of patient care, because the reassurance helps calm the patient.<br><br>Pitfall: the duty is to ensure the effort is made, not to personally track the family down.
